The facts, relevant for disposal of this petition, arc that opposite party No.1 as plaintiff brought Title Suit No.33 of 2004 on 28.03.2004 in the Court of Assistant Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka with the prayer for declaration of the effect that the deed of power of attorney made in favour of the petitioner by his wife, Syeda Sarfunnessa, is void, illegal, collusive and not binding upon contemnor (respondent) No.1. Said suit was subsequently transferred to the Court of Assistant Judge, Nawabgonj, Dhaka and renumbered as Title Suit No.92 of 2004. Thereafter, the said suit was again transferred to the Court of Assistant Judge (Additional Assistant Judge Court), 14th Court, Dhaka and renumbered as Title Suit No.100 of 2006. 

 3. The Contemnor (respondent) then brought an application for injunction under Order XXXIX, rules 1 and 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure 1908. The learned Assistant Judge, 4th Additional Assistant Judge Court, Dhaka rejected the same vide his order dated 20.02.2006. 

 4. Thereafter, the contemnor as appellant preferred Miscellaneous Appeal No.105 of 2007 before the District Judge, Dhaka against the order dated 20.02.2006 where the contemnor also filed an application for injunction. District Judge passed an order of status-quo instead of injunction till disposal of the said miscellaneous appeal. This appeal was finally heard by the learned Judge, First Court of Additional District Judge, Dhaka who affirmed the order of the 4th Court of the Assistant Judge, Dhaka dated 20.02.2006 vide his judgment and order dated 12.08.2008.
